name: preflight-checklist
title: Preflight Checklist
description: Checklist that locks an action until auto and manual checks pass, names the blockers, resets manual ticks and re-runs checks when the revision changes, and re-verifies right before the action runs.

meta.summary: Locks a deploy or publish button until automatic and manual checks pass, and re-verifies right before it runs.
meta.server: Gate the real deploy in CI or the API with the same required checks.
catches: Action started with failing or pending checks
Manual ticks left over from an earlier revision
A check that started failing since it was ticked: re-verified on run
Auto-check that throws: counted as a failure
limits: The lock is in this UI; the same action through an API or CLI isn't gated
Checks are only as good as the functions you pass
a11y: Each check row is focusable and its state is read as text
Status is a polite live region linked to the action button
Locked action uses aria-disabled and stays focusable
Re-run button has a title and visually hidden text
